source.title: Why Gmail and Linktree Cost Your Business Revenue

creative_brief.audience: A local service business owner whose social profile, general inbox, and bio link are carrying their entire customer journey.
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A rented hallway of closed doors becomes an owned front door that can answer a visitor without making them wait.

claim_ledger.claim: A link-in-bio page can route a visitor but does not itself answer practical booking questions.
The Web Basics Bundle is $199 for its first year and business email setup is a separate $99 add-on.

scenes.visual_purpose: Make the abstract problem physical before naming a platform.
scenes.visual: Predawn: a visitor reaches a narrow, unmarked hallway with several identical closed doors; one phone glow is the only guide.
scenes.copy_or_narration: If every path to your business ends at someone else's doorway, customers have to work to find you.
scenes.asset_needed: Text-free vertical establishing plate; one locked camera shot.

scenes.visual_purpose: Show the visitor's question becoming a delay instead of a conversation.
scenes.visual: A simple paper appointment card slides under a closed door and waits untouched while a phone notification blinks once.
scenes.copy_or_narration: A bio link can point somewhere. It cannot answer what you charge or when you are free while you are working.
scenes.asset_needed: Close controlled insert; physical paper and door detail.

scenes.visual_purpose: Contrast a chain of hand-offs with a destination built to answer.
scenes.visual: Overhead tabletop: three small directional arrows lead through tiny door tokens; the final token is a keyed, clearly owned front door.
scenes.copy_or_narration: The point is not to abandon social. It is to give the link a real destination that belongs to your business.
scenes.asset_needed: Designed graphic scene assembled in HyperFrames, with no generated UI.

scenes.visual_purpose: Make ownership feel useful, not territorial.
scenes.visual: The owned door opens onto a calm, practical workspace: price card, service card, and appointment card are organized on a table; their type is added later in composition.
scenes.copy_or_narration: Now the visitor can understand the service and choose a next step without waiting for an inbox reply.
scenes.asset_needed: Text-free hero plate with quiet areas for deterministic labels.
continuity_locks: warm practical light after the doorway

scenes.visual_purpose: State the precise offer without letting the model invent scope.
scenes.visual: The workspace resolves into an orderly owned-front-door composition; HyperFrames supplies a sourced offer card.
scenes.copy_or_narration: A focused website launch starts at $199 for the first year. Business email setup is separate at $99.
scenes.asset_needed: HyperFrames offer card; no generated plate text.

scenes.visual_purpose: Land the metaphor and give a restrained next step.
scenes.visual: Exterior of the same front door at morning. It is open, marked only by a composed FAMtastic end card.
scenes.copy_or_narration: Keep the link. Change where it leads.
scenes.asset_needed: Return-to-opening plate plus deterministic end card.
continuity_locks: no URL rendered by image model
